title: Supervised fine-tuning of TabICL-v2 on the champion route view: can the best-decorrelated candidate become strong enough? (catalogue items 31 + 13)
motivation: TabICL's zero-shot route-view screen measured the BEST decorrelation of any strong-ish candidate (corr 0.9828 vs champion route arm, 0.9843 vs portfolio -- every other non-FLM candidate sits >= 0.989) but standalone lagged at 0.956343 (-5.5e-3 vs champion route). Both closure ledgers (FLM rich-view, neural) named supervised fine-tuning as the ONLY reopening mechanism. The installed tabicl package ships FinetunedTabICLClassifier (supervised meta-batch fine-tuning of the pretrained checkpoint). If fine-tuning lifts standalone toward ~0.960 while decorrelation survives (fine-tuning on FIT could also pull it UP toward the champion -- that trade is exactly what this measures), the combination of BOTH conditions is unprecedented in this campaign.

scope.cannot: pass the OOF admission gate; justify a submission; or establish private performance
scope.purpose: decide whether fine-tuned TabICL merits a full 5-fold OOF + admission-gate run

protocol.view: route (champion raw22 via frames(); the SAME representation the champion's own TabPFN arm uses). Rationale: (a) the 285-feature rich view OOM'd TabICL three times at 16GB (RESOURCE_BLOCKED, recorded); (b) the decorrelation that motivates this experiment was measured on the route view -- keeping the view isolates fine-tuning as the single changed factor vs the frozen zero-shot reference.
protocol.split: inner 10% stratified of FIT as X_val/y_val (epoch selection + early stop; fold-safe -- never the eval fold). X_train = remaining 90% of FIT. Scaler: none (TabICL has internal preprocessing, identical to its zero-shot screen).

model.note: 10 epochs is deliberately conservative (default 30): the zero-shot checkpoint is already strong; the risk is over-fine-tuning INTO the champion's decision boundary (correlation rise), and 10 epochs bounds both compute and that drift. No epoch/arg sweep: one frozen recipe.
model.shim_disclosure: tabicl._finetune imports 4 LR-scheduler functions from `transformers`, absent from the certified .venv. Installing it in place is forbidden (certified-stack policy); scripts/phase20/_shims/transformers.py reproduces the standard HuggingFace LambdaLR semantics (constant/linear/cosine/polynomial) and is prepended to sys.path for this run only. The fine-tuner's used scheduler (cosine_warmup) is thereby faithfully provided. Amended into this prereg BEFORE any fine-tuned prediction existed (first invocation died at ModuleNotFoundError).

metrics.standalone_auc: exact AUC on full fold-0 (139927 rows)
metrics.logit_pearson_vs_route: decorrelation vs champion route arm (the TabPFN member this replaces-or-joins)

decision_rule.DECORRELATION_COLLAPSE: if standalone improves but corr_vs_route >= 0.99, fine-tuning has simply distilled the champion's own inductive bias into TabICL: close the fine-tuning mechanism for this checkpoint
decision_rule.NEGATIVE: standalone fails to improve materially (< +2e-3 over zero-shot): supervised fine-tuning of in-context learners closes for this data size
decision_rule.note: PROMISING only means 'run full 5-fold OOF + admission gate'.

anti_leakage: X_train/X_val are both subsets of FIT; the eval fold is never used for training, epoch selection, or validation.
The route view is label-free (no TE).
The champion reference is loaded from hash-asserted phase17_B1 artifacts.
No public-LB feedback of any kind enters the recipe choice; the recipe is frozen here.

budget.gpu: <= 2 GPU-h (fine-tuning backprop over the pretrained checkpoint; bounded by 10 epochs / 10k chunks)

predeclared_followups: PROMISING -> full 5-fold OOF with the same frozen fine-tuning recipe per fold + admission gate.
DECORRELATION_COLLAPSE or NEGATIVE -> fine-tuning closes for TabICL; item 13 (TabPFN-3 vs 2.6 checkpoint swap) remains separate and is NOT authorized by this prereg.
A rich-view fine-tune remains blocked until the 16GB OOM constraint is solved (different GPU or a chunked-predict patch); it is NOT part of this experiment.
